1[378ZB. Share capital.--(1) The share capital of a Producer Company shall consist of equity shares only.
(2) The shares held by a Member in a Producer Company, shall as far as may be, be in proportion to the patronage of that company.]
footnote: </br><hr style="border-top:1px solid #0778be"/>1. Ins. by Act 29 of 2020, s. 52 (w.e.f. 11-2-2021).</br><hr style="border-top:1px solid #0778be"/>
